Accept.description: media types and extensions, such as .json or text/*; empty takes every file

AccessibilityAttributes.description: A2UI 1.0's accessibility attributes: a label and a description for assistive technologies.

CatalogId.description: The catalog ID for this component, overriding any surface-level default catalogId (A2UI 1.0's ComponentCommon).

ComponentId.description: The id of a component on the same surface (A2UI 1.0's ComponentId): a component's own id, or the id of the child, the menu or the map it names.

ComponentMetadata.description: Optional component-level metadata for vendor extensions, written as the component's @metadata key (A2UI 1.0's ComponentCommon).

DataBinding.description: A2UI 1.0's data binding: a JSON pointer into the data model. v0.9.1's {"path": ...} is not one.

@path.description: a JSON pointer into the data model

TextOrBinding.description: a literal, or a DataBinding into the data model

anyFunction.description: This catalog declares no functions of its own; a surface calls the basic catalog's functions, so no function call validates against this catalog alone.

ApprovalCard.description: the electorate's ballot over the vote capability

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

Chat.description: The one agentic chat: a thread of ChatMessage rows as bubbles, the agent named over it, suggestions, a Send box, drafts kept across redraws, times in the viewer's zone, the visitor's own thread; a progress line and the agent's steps from the line's ChatProgress in the A2A task words, and 'the agent stopped' with Retry when it lapses while working; Markdown answers with code blocks that copy; attachment and citation chips; the controls copy, retry, stop and feedback as actions.

agent.description: the agent that answers, named over the thread

attach.description: a person attaches files: dropped on the chat, picked, or sent from a FileTree's Ask about

controls.description: the controls under an answer: copy its text, retry (a new line in reply to the same question), stop (the chat.stop action), feedback (two icon buttons, thumbs up Helpful and thumbs down Not helpful, each with its pressed state: the chat.feedback action with up or down, sent again only when the person changes the choice, which the chat keeps per line for the page's life)

files.description: the path of the SharedFile rows, which name the attachment and citation chips

format.description: how an answer without its own format reads; an answer of text/markdown always draws as safe Markdown

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

key.description: the thread; a visitor with no sign-on writes into its own thread of it

placeholder.description: the hint in the empty message box

preview.description: the id of a FilePreview a citation chip opens its file in

progress.description: the path of the ChatProgress rows

reads.description: the path of the ChatMessage rows

suggestions.description: questions offered as chips over the Send box; a tap sends the chip's whole text as the person's line. A list of strings, or a DataBinding to a list the agent writes, never both, so a page's starters are bound rows too. A bound item is a string or a row {text, label, line}: text is the line a tap sends; label, at most 60 characters, the chip's words when they differ (the full text is the chip's title); line, the id of the agent line the chip follows: such a chip draws only while that line is the newest line of the thread, hides when the person sends a new line, and a row with no line always draws. At most 8 chips draw, each cut at 120 characters with its full text as its title and sent whole.

writeAction.description: the action a sent line dispatches with {type: ChatMessage, entry}; a visitor's secret rides only with the page's write action

ChatInput.description: a thread per key as chat bubbles, replies, attachments, suggested questions; an alias of Chat through 0.6.x, drawn by it

agent.description: the agent that answers, named over the thread

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

key.description: the conversation key shown; empty for every key

placeholder.description: the hint in the empty message box

suggestions.description: questions offered as chips under the thread; a tap sends the question as a line

FilePreview.description: One file drawn by its media type: text and Markdown through Prose, CSV as a table of its first rows, PNG and JPEG as an image, PDF in a sandboxed frame, HTML and SVG as text; above maxBytes it says too large to preview and offers Download.

csvRows.description: the rows of a CSV drawn

file.description: a literal file id, or {"@path": ...} into the data model where a FileTree puts the person's choice

files.description: the path of the SharedFile rows the file is found in

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

kinds.description: the media types drawn; every other draws as text when it is text, else offers Download

maxBytes.description: the largest file previewed, at most 16 MiB

FileShare.description: upload to the content swarm, list, download, share; an alias of FileTree through 0.6.x, drawn by it as a flat list

accept.description: the media types and extensions a drop takes, such as .json or text/*; empty takes every file

attest.description: a statement the person ticks before a drop; its words travel with each upload as the lawful basis

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

label.description: the words on the drop zone

maxBytes.description: the largest file, shown as a hint and checked on the page; the feed's own cap decides

notice.description: a line shown over the drop, such as who can read what is dropped

FileTree.description: Files as a tree (the WAI-ARIA Tree View pattern): folders from SharedFile.path, expand and collapse, a badge per file (an agent working on it, written by an agent, new or changed since this person looked), upload by drop or by a button, download, and a context menu with Ask about, Download, Share, Rename and Remove; Share, Rename and Remove are actions the host applies.

accept.description: the media types and extensions an upload takes; empty takes every file

actions.description: the items of a file's context menu

agents.description: the names whose files carry the agent badge; empty takes the agents of the WorkingOn rows

badges.description: the badges drawn; all four when absent

chat.description: the id of a Chat that Ask about attaches a file to

flat.description: a flat list by name, as FileShare draws

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

maxBytes.description: the largest upload, checked on the page; the feed's own cap decides

preview.description: the id of a FilePreview a file opens in when chosen

reads.description: the path of the SharedFile-shaped rows

upload.description: an Upload button and a drop on the tree; a drop on a folder lands under its path

working.description: the path of the WorkingOn rows that badge the files an agent holds

FileTree.writes: an upload, or a file action

events.description: the events shown when the data model has none

id.description: the component's id, unique on its surface

description: The raw widgets of an application over a group's entries (https://badmonkey.ai/agentspaces/a2ui/v1/). Each component reads a list from the surface's data model and writes an entry back through the host's callbacks, with no dependency on a platform record; the A2UI basic catalog and agentspaces-viz are assumed beside it, so a page puts a TitleBar over a Split of its tree, its preview and its chat.
title: AgentSpaces widgets catalog
